text: Victor Hugo's Notre-Dame de Paris, known as The Hunchback of Notre-Dame, was among the novels placed on the Index in 1834 as pernicious reading. It was added for its portrayal of corrupt clergy and anti-clerical subtext, and stayed on the Index until 1966. In 2016 it was among the titles barred by Kuwait's Ministry of Information censorship committee.
meta_description: The Hunchback of Notre-Dame by Victor Hugo: placed on the Index in 1834 and removed from it in 1966; also barred by Kuwait's censorship committee in 2016.
